newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Inflation still a risk in New Zealand - Peters.
newsitem.headline: Inflation still a risk in New Zealand - Peters.

text.p: Recent data on the housing market, wage rates and price expectation surveys demonstrate inflation remains a risk in New Zealand, Treasurer Winston Peters said on Tuesday.
Peters said that, in addition, the rise in the Balance of Payments deficit was evidence that domestic spending was putting pressure on the country's external competitiveness.
"Now is not the time for a fiscal easing, which might increase the imbalance between domestic strength and external pressure," he said.
